title: Manager-DataPlatformEngineer
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana

**Requisition ID** 2026-124082 **Category** Engineering & Software Development **Position type** Regular

  

**Your opportunity**
--------------------

  
  

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.

Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region

**What you have**
-----------------

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

Platform Frameworks & Engineering Standards
  

* Design and build reusable data platform frameworks for ingestion, transformation, validation, and consumption.
* Establish standardized patterns for data pipelines, APIs, and visualization layers across SAMDA.
* Define best practices for schema evolution, versioning, error handling, and observability.
* Influence platform roadmap through hands on engineering leadership.

Design & Build Advanced Data Pipelines
  

* Architect and implement complex, cloud native ETL/ELT pipelines supporting investment and analytical data.
* Build reliable workflows using GCS, Dataproc, Cloud Dataflow, Composer (Airflow), and Pub/Sub.
* Implement scalable transformations and curated layers in Snowflake and cloud data warehouses.

Investment Data Domain Focus
  
This role has deep ownership within the Investment Data domain, including but not limited to:
  

* Holdings, positions, transactions, cash flows, and security master data
* Portfolio, account, and instrument hierarchies
* Performance, risk, exposure, and attribution datasets
* Reference data, taxonomies, and domain models that support downstream analytics and reporting

The engineer is responsible for designing domain driven data models and operational data stores that accurately represent investment concepts and scale across multiple SAM products and platforms.
  
Investment Data Modeling & Domain Engineering
  

* Design enterprise grade investment data models using Kimball, relational, and domain driven design principles.
* Create operational and analytical data stores from the ground up, including taxonomies and canonical models.
* Ensure models support regulatory, performance, and investment analytics use cases.

Data APIs & Service Layer
  

* Design and implement Data APIs using Python (FastAPI / Flask) to expose curated investment datasets.
* Build scalable, secure RESTful services for analytical and operational consumers.
* governance, access control, and data protection standards aligned with regulated environments.

Python Dashboards & Data Visualization
  

* Develop Python based dashboards and UI applications using Streamlit, Dash, Panel, or similar frameworks.
* Create interactive visualizations using Plotly, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to support investment insights.
* Translate complex investment data into intuitive, self service analytical experiences.

Advanced Cloud & Application Engineering
  

* Build data and application services using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and Cloud SQL.
* distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Beam, and Flink.
* Package and deploy data services, APIs, and UI components using Docker.

DevOps, CI/CD & Automation
  

* Lead CI/CD design for pipelines, APIs, and visualization apps using Git, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions.
* Implement automated testing, deployment, and release management patterns.
* Drive infrastructure automation using Terraform or Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

Data Quality, Reliability & Observability
  

* Define and implement data quality frameworks, reconciliation checks, and monitoring standards.
* Proactively identify and resolve complex data, platform, and application issues.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  

* Act as a senior technical leader and mentor for data engineers across SAMDA.
* Lead design reviews and influence cross team engineering decisions.
* Communicate complex platform and investment data concepts to technical and business stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* 6–8 years of experience building cloud based data platforms and enterprise data solutions.
* Strong experience in the Investment or Asset Management data domain.
* Hands on expertise with Snowflake and GCP services (GCS, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Cloud SQL).
* Advanced proficiency in Python for data engineering, API development, and visualization.
* Proven experience building REST APIs using Python frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent).
* Experience with Python visualization and UI frameworks (Streamlit, Dash, Panel, or similar).
* Strong background with distributed processing frameworks (Spark, Beam, or Flink).
* Expertise in CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and infrastructure as code (Terraform or GCP Deployment Manager).

  
**Tools & Technologies**
  

* Cloud: GCP (GCS, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, Composer)
* Data Warehouses: Snowflake, BigQuery
* Processing: Spark, Beam, Flink
* APIs: Python (FastAPI, Flask)
* Visualization/UI: Streamlit, Dash, Panel, Plotly, Matplotlib, Seaborn
* DevOps: Git, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker
* IaC: Terraform, Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Experience designing platform level frameworks adopted by multiple engineering teams.
  

* Deep understanding of regulated data environments, governance, lineage, and auditability.
* Strong grasp of modern data architecture and self service analytics patterns.
* Ability to influence platform strategy and mentor senior engineers.
* Excellent documentation and executive level communication skills.

  

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

**Our base benefits, wellbeing, and total rewards include:**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

title: AWS Solutions Expert
description:
Role Type:

Full-time

Location:

Hyderabad

We are seeking an AWS Solutions Expert with an experience of 5 years and above to architect, build, and secure highly scalable, distributed serverless applications. You will own design decisions, drive best practices for identity and access management, data persistence, container orchestration, and automated delivery pipelines. Exposure to large language models and multi-agent systems is a strong plus. Prior experience in leading small teams is desired.

##### **Qualifications**

* Masters/Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of hands‑on experience designing and implementing AWS solutions.
* Deep expertise in:

  + Serverless services (Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS/SNS)
  + Container orchestration (EKS/Kubernetes)
  + Relational databases (RDS, Aurora)
  + AWS IAM, security controls, encryption, network isolation
* Proven track record building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and automated testing frameworks.
* Strong scripting skills (Python, Node.js, or similar).
* Excellent communication, documentation, and leadership abilities.

* Exposure to large language models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and multi-agent architectures.
* Experience with CDK, Terraform, or Serverless Framework.
* Familiarity with observability tools: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch.
* AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer).

##### **Responsibilities**

* **Architecture & Design**

  + Lead solutioning for distributed, serverless workloads on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, SNS).
  + Design resilient, secure, and cost-optimized architectures using RDS, DynamoDB, Aurora Serverless, and EKS.
* **Security & IAM**

  + Develop and enforce AWS IAM policies, least-privilege roles, Service Control Policies, and SCPs.
  + Implement security best practices (VPC design, KMS encryption, AWS WAF, Security Hub).
* **Infrastructure Automation**

  + Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Workflows.
  + Author Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) with CloudFormation, Terraform or CDK.
  + Integrate automated testing (unit, integration, security scanning) nto deployment pipelines.
* **Operational Excellence**

  + Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize performance of serverless functions and container clusters.
  + Implement logging and observability using CloudWatch, X-Ray, Prometheus, Grafana.
* **Innovation & Collaboration**

  + Stay current on AWS feature releases; evaluate and adopt new services.
  + Partner with product, data science, and ML engineering teams—especially those building LLM-driven and multi-agent solutions.
  + Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge through documentation and tech talks.

From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**

**Our Mission & Vision**

* Our Mission: To place doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty-specific cloud platform.
* Our Vision: A world where the software ModMed builds increases medical-practice success and improves patient outcomes.
* Our Core Values: Create customer delight | Save time | Innovate boldly, then make things happen | Align passion with purpose | Think big | Have fun | Do good.

title: Wireless Firmware Engineer
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Job Type

Full Time

Workspace

Hyderabad, India

**About the Role**
------------------

About the Role  
We are looking for a firmware engineer who understands radios as well as code. You will build firmware for long-range, low-power wireless devices and test tools, from radio drivers and protocol stacks to key storage, over-the-air updates and field validation. You will think in link budgets, timing and security, not just in registers.  
  
You will work directly with the Principal Architect on connected products where reliability in the field, power efficiency and security matter as much as features.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Radio and Protocol Firmware**

* Develop and maintain **LoRa and LoRaWAN** protocol stacks (1.0.x and 1.1): activation, device classes, receive windows, MAC commands, adaptive data rate and regional parameters.
* Apply **spread-spectrum and frequency-hopping radio concepts**, and bring up new radio chipsets and modes behind a clean driver interface.
* Implement robust **retry, acknowledgement and duplicate-handling strategies** for lossy and high-latency links.

#### **Link and RF Engineering**

* Perform **link-budget analysis** and interpret sensitivity, interference and range-test data.
* Account for **frequency stability and timing** (crystal and TCXO choice, drift, offset handling) in radio design and firmware.
* Run **field range and reliability trials**, and turn the results into firmware and configuration improvements.

#### **Security and Key Management**

* Implement AES-128 and AES-CMAC correctly, and manage keys in **protected storage or a secure element**.
* Design **secure device activation and key lifecycle**: provisioning, rotation, revocation, and safe persistence of counters across resets.
* Build **signed over-the-air updates** with a secure boot chain.

#### **Drivers, Gateways and Test**

* Write **SPI radio drivers** and work with gateway-side software (concentrator HALs, packet forwarders and bridges) and timing sources.
* Build **test infrastructure**: Python simulators, hardware-in-the-loop automation, power profiling and instrument-based RF validation.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Communications, Embedded Systems or a related field.

#### **Experience:**

* **4–5+ years** of embedded C/C++ on ARM Cortex-M with an RTOS.
* Hands-on wireless protocol work (LoRa/LoRaWAN or a similar low-power wide-area technology), including field debugging.

### **Technical Skills Required**

#### **Embedded Core**

* FreeRTOS or Zephyr, interrupt-driven design, low-power design with measured sleep currents.

#### **Radio and Protocols**

* LoRa PHY parameters (spreading factor, bandwidth, coding rate), LoRaWAN MAC internals, modulation fundamentals, sensitivity and link-budget reasoning.

#### **Security**

* AES-CMAC and AES-CTR, key storage, secure boot, safe counter handling.

#### **Instruments and Tools**

* Spectrum analyser, power profiler, protocol sniffers, logic analyser, JTAG/SWD.

#### **Software Tooling**

* Python, Git and CI.

### **Preferred (Bonus) Skills**

* SDR capture and analysis (IQ recordings, GNU Radio) and DSP fundamentals.
* GNSS and precise timing, or FPGA basics.
* Embedded Rust, and RF certification experience (WPC, ETSI, FCC).

### **Why Join Us**

At **EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD**, we design and deliver connected electronics from idea to deployment. Work on the radio-to-cloud path of real long-range IoT products, with test equipment and field trials, not just simulation. You will see your firmware tested against physics.

### **How to Apply**

Send your updated resume along with links to relevant projects, GitHub or portfolio work to **jobs@eurthtech.com**, or use the application form on this page.

**About the Company**
---------------------

About EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD  
EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD is a cutting-edge Electronics Product Design and Engineering firm specializing in embedded systems, IoT solutions, and high-performance hardware development. We provide end-to-end product development services—from PCB design, firmware development, and system architecture to manufacturing and scalable deployment.  
  
With deep expertise in embedded software, signal processing, AI-driven edge computing, RF communication, and ultra-low-power design, we build next-generation industrial automation, consumer electronics, and smart infrastructure solutions.  
  
Our Core Capabilities  
Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering – Architecting robust, real-time embedded solutions with RTOS, Linux, and MCU/SoC-based firmware.  
IoT & Wireless Technologies – Developing LoRa, BLE, Wi-Fi, UWB, and 5G-based connected solutions for industrial and smart city applications.  
Hardware & PCB Design – High-performance PCB layout, signal integrity optimization, and design for manufacturing (DFM/DFA).  
Product Prototyping & Manufacturing – Accelerating concept-to-market with rapid prototyping, design validation, and scalable production.  
AI & Edge Computing – Implementing real-time AI/ML on embedded devices for predictive analytics, automation, and security.  
Security & Cryptography – Integrating post-quantum cryptography, secure boot, and encrypted firmware updates.  
  
Our Industry Impact  
✅ IoT & Smart Devices – Powering the next wave of connected solutions for industrial automation, logistics, and smart infrastructure.  
✅ Medical & Wearable Tech – Designing low-power biomedical devices with precision sensor fusion and embedded intelligence.  
✅ Automotive & Industrial Automation – Developing AI-enhanced control systems, predictive maintenance tools, and real-time monitoring solutions.  
✅ Scalable Enterprise & B2B Solutions – Delivering custom embedded hardware and software tailored to OEMs, manufacturers, and system integrators.  
  
Our Vision  
We are committed to advancing technology and innovation in embedded product design. With a focus on scalability, security, and efficiency, we empower businesses with intelligent, connected, and future-ready solutions.  
  
We currently cater to B2B markets, offering customized embedded development services, with a roadmap to expand into direct-to-consumer (B2C) solutions.

title: Architect I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role description**

Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)

Location: UST Hyderabad

Type: Full time, in-house

About the role

Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write

audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green

deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.

We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You

will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.

What you will do

Architecture and roadmap

* + Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.

* + Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.

* + Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.

* + Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security

* + Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).

* + Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.

* + Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate

* + Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.

* + Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.

* + Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.

* + Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.

Work with others

* + Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.

* + Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.

* + Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring

Experience

* + 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.

* + You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.

* + You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical

* + AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.

* + Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.

* + Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.

* + Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.

* + Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.

* + Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working

* + You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.

* + You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.

* + You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)

* + AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional

* + Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

* + A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have

* + Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.

* + Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.

* + FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.

* + Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like

* A written target architecture for multi-tenant Codon on AWS and Azure, reviewed with Security and Network, with a sequenced plan.

2.Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.

3.A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.

4.The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.

5.Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

  
**Skills**

AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: AI Solution expert
description:
**Job Title: AI Solutions Expert**

**Location : Hyderabad**

  

**About the Company**

  

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.

  

**About the Role:**

As an AI Solutions Expert/Specialist, you will own the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions that automate and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle across a global CPG organization. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.

This includes finance, commercial, advertising, social media, e-commerce, email marketing, HCP communications, packaging, point-of-sale materials, in-store activations, and regulatory submissions.

* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, foundation models, and Azure services to continuously advance the content ecosystem

* Mentor developers and engineers on AI/ML engineering patterns, cloud-native development, and Azure best practices

* 8+ years of experience in software/application development, with a significant portion focused on AI/ML solution engineering

* Hands-on expertise with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure Cognitive/AI Services

* Experience with generative AI for image, video, and/or multi-modal content creation

* Solid experience designing and operating data pipelines in Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Event Grid, or equivalent)

* Proficiency in Python and at least one additional enterprise language (C#, TypeScript, Java)

* Strong understanding of API design, microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS), and cloud-native patterns

* Experience deploying AI solutions through the full maturity curve: POC MVP enterprise production

* Hands-on experience with DevOps and MLOps tooling — Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, MLflow, model versioning, drift monitoring, automated retraining, and A/B testing in production

* Working knowledge of database technologies including Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, Azure Synapse)

* Experience building with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen

* Familiarity with front-end and full-stack patterns (React or Angular, FastAPI/Flask backends, serverless architectures) to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**Required Technical Skills:**

Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Bot Service

Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Event Hub / Event Grid, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Data Lake

LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX

Deep Agents, Agentic Workflow developments, multi-modal pipelines

**App Development**

REST / GraphQL APIs, React or Angular, FastAPI / Flask, microservices, serverless, event-driven architectures

Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Managed Identity, responsible AI tooling, content safety APIs

**General Business**

Good to Have — Domain & Business Experience.

* Experience working in or with CPG, FMCG, consumer health, or pharmaceutical organizations

* Familiarity with consumer advertising and media production workflows (TV, digital, social, programmatic)

* Exposure to social media content operations, scheduling platforms, and performance analytics

* Understanding of e-commerce product content (product descriptions, A+ content, marketplace listings)

* Awareness of email marketing and CRM-driven personalization tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)

* Experience with HCP and medical affairs communications in regulated environments

* Knowledge of packaging artwork, labeling workflows, and regulatory/legal review cycles

* Familiarity with point-of-sale and in-store activation material production

* Experience with PIM and DAM platforms (Salsify, Akeneo, Adobe AEM, Bynder, or similar)

* Understanding of regulatory submission, claims substantiation, and content compliance frameworks (FDA, EU MDR, local market regulations)

* Exposure to localization and transcreation processes across global markets

* Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Veeva, Salesforce, or Others

* Azure certifications (AI Engineer Associate, Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)

* Track record of working in AI Centers of Excellence or capability-building functions

* Experience managing vendor and agency relationships for AI tooling and creative technology

  

What You’ll Impact.

* Speed and cost-efficiency of content production across global markets

* Brand consistency and regulatory compliance across all consumer and professional touchpoints

* Data-driven decision-making through AI-powered content insights and performance analytics

* AI agentic automation and process efficiency gains

* The organization’s long-term AI and content technology roadmap

  
  

**Why us?**  
  
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
  
  
We Are Challengers.
  
We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:
  
  
All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
  
Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.

Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

*Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development.* ***AutoRABIT platform overview***

*Provide technical leadership across AutoRABIT products and shared platform capabilities. Combine exceptional hands-on engineering with a strong view of customer needs, product differentiation and long-term technical direction. Your mandate is to improve the company’s ability to build products customers trust and choose, and to translate that direction into working software.*

Partner with the CTO on enterprise direction and the VP of Engineering on execution. Agree decision rights for cross-product initiatives and make outcomes visible to leadership and the teams delivering them.*
* *Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.*

title: Tech Architect
description:
**Position Details**

* Department: Engineering / Technology
* Reports to: VP of Engineering / CTO
* Location: Hyderabad, India
* Work arrangement: In-office only
* Employment type: Full-time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Tech Architect to define and drive the technical direction of our SaaS platform. You will architect and build scalable backend web services; design analytics pipelines for drone-captured images and videos; enable enterprise-grade single sign-on (SSO) and a secure, extensible integration layer; and turn proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. You will also champion AI/LLM-powered agentic coding to improve engineering productivity, while setting high standards for security, quality, scalability, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define end-to-end architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, balancing scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost.
* Assess existing POC and prototype code, determine what can be reused versus re-architected, and define a practical path to production and go-live.
* Production-harden prototypes through robust error handling, logging, monitoring, automated testing, security controls, configuration management, and performance tuning.
* Own production-readiness reviews, load and performance testing, CI/CD and deployment strategies (including blue-green and canary releases), rollback plans, and post-launch support.
* Architect scalable analytics pipelines for drone-captured imagery and video, covering live-stream and bulk-field-upload ingestion, processing, model inference, storage, and API-based delivery of results.
* Address drone-data constraints, including large high-resolution media, intermittent or low-bandwidth connectivity, GPS and flight telemetry, altitude, gimbal/camera orientation, timestamps, and mapping data to missions, sites, and assets.
* Make architecture decisions for real-time versus batch processing, GPU/accelerator utilization, edge versus cloud inference, and cost optimization for media-heavy workloads.
* Architect enterprise identity and SSO using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0; support per-tenant SSO configuration, integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and session management.
* Design and own the platform’s extensibility and integration layer, including public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension models for customer, partner, third-party, drone-platform, and fleet-management integrations, with versioning, backward compatibility, and safe sandboxing.
* Own end-to-end security architecture, including API gateway and WAF controls, authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets and key management, audit logging, and tenant data isolation.
* Drive secure-by-design practices through threat modelling, security reviews of designs and code, dependency and vulnerability management, and penetration-test remediation—including for AI-generated code and third-party extensions/integrations.
* Architect and oversee backend services, including REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and service-to-service communication.
* Remain hands-on: write and review production-grade backend code, build POCs, and demonstrate engineering standards by example.
* Design core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, subscription and billing integration, tenant data isolation, rate limiting, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead adoption of AI/LLM agentic coding tools such as Claude Code for delivery acceleration, refactoring, and productionizing prototype code.
* Establish workflows and best practices for AI-assisted software development, including code-review standards, guardrails, and quality gates for AI-generated code.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Define technical standards, coding guidelines, and architectural patterns across engineering teams; evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, tools, and emerging AI/LLM and computer-vision capabilities.
* Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs), guide low-level designs (LLDs), identify technical debt, and lead legacy-system modernization, using AI-assisted tools where beneficial.
* Ensure architecture meets non-functional requirements for scalability, availability, security, tenant isolation, and observability.
* Mentor senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, productionizing prototypes, and effective use of AI coding assistants.
* Lead POCs for new technologies, LLM/agentic workflows, vision models, and major system changes.
* Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD architecture.
* Own architecture documentation and keep it current across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in architecture-focused roles.
* Proven experience building and scaling SaaS products end to end, ideally from early-stage development through growth.
* A demonstrated track record of taking POCs/prototypes to production through refactoring, re-architecture, hardening, and successful live launches with measurable reliability and performance.
* Strong backend engineering experience designing, building, and scaling production REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices.
* Experience designing or building systems that ingest and process drone-generated aerial imagery and video at scale, including use cases such as object detection, change detection, classification, tracking, and inspection.
* Understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS), encoding/transcoding, and large-scale media storage.
* Experience with drone data and metadata, including geo-tagged imagery, flight telemetry, geospatial context, and data flows from device or ground station to cloud.
* Familiarity with production deployment and serving of computer-vision/ML models, including inference optimization, GPU workloads, batching, and model versioning; exposure to OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar frameworks.
* Hands-on experience implementing enterprise SSO and authentication using SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and SCIM in multi-tenant SaaS products, including integration with major identity providers.
* Experience designing extensible platforms with public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension or third-party integration frameworks, including versioning, rate limiting, and safe extension isolation.
* Strong security architecture skills covering API security, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, secure SDLC, threat modelling, and OWASP Top 10 risks and mitigations.
* Mandatory hands-on coding capability; this is an active engineering role, not solely an architecture-review position.
* Practical, demonstrable use of AI/LLM-based agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) in real engineering workflows, beyond casual use.
* Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing systems, and SaaS scalability patterns.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed GPU/ML and media services.
* Deep proficiency in at least one major backend language/stack: Java, Python, Node.js, .NET, or Go.
* Deep understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, caching strategies (Redis or Memcached), and object storage.
* Strong experience with API design, API gateways, messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and service-integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and production observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
* Understanding of LLM fundamentals—prompting, context management, tool/function calling, RAG, agentic workflows, and multimodal models—sufficient to architect responsible AI integrations.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Working knowledge of compliance and data-control frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, including privacy and data-retention considerations for aerial imagery and video. Regulated-industry experience is a plus, not mandatory.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading architecture reviews and building consensus across engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with drone SDKs/platforms such as DJI, MAVLink, PX4, or ArduPilot, or with drone fleet and mission-management software.
* Experience with geospatial and photogrammetry tooling, including GIS, orthomosaics, 3D reconstruction, GDAL, or PostGIS.
* Experience with edge/on-device inference or low-latency real-time video processing at a ground station or on a drone.
* Experience with video analytics platforms or stream-processing frameworks such as GStreamer, NVIDIA DeepStream, or Triton Inference Server.
* Experience building a developer ecosystem or marketplace, including partner APIs, app/extension marketplaces, and developer portals.
* Experience with zero-trust architecture, mutual TLS (mTLS), WAF/API-gateway policy design, or security tooling such as SAST/DAST and SIEM integrations.
* Experience with API monetization, usage-based billing, or SaaS metering systems.
* Experience building or integrating LLM-powered applications or agents in production.
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-tooling frameworks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Experience with SRE practices, including SLOs/SLAs, incident response, and capacity planning.
* Prior experience scaling SaaS systems from startup to enterprise scale.
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF, or security certifications.

**Role Expectations**

* Be a hands-on technical leader who can move fluidly between architecture, implementation, code review, production readiness, and technical mentoring.
* Balance rapid delivery with long-term maintainability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Build consensus across teams and communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Application note: Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate hands-on backend engineering, productionizing POCs, SaaS architecture, drone-media/data pipeline design, enterprise SSO and security architecture, and practical use of AI-assisted coding tools.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

title: Assoc. Dir. DDIT ISC CSOC Engineering - Cloud
description:
### **Summary**

We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Detection Engineer to help shape the future of cloud security monitoring at Novartis. You will design, build, validate and continuously improve detection capabilities across Azure, AWS and other strategic cloud platforms while being a key partner with incident response and cloud security architect teams. An engineering role that combines cloud telemetry, custom detections, threat research, automation and AI-assisted investigation to create high-signal, scalable outcomes for Cyber Defense.
  
  
Role purpose:
  
  
Build a robust, AI-native cloud detection pipeline that improves correlation and investigation efficiency across multi-cloud environments. Engineer fragmented cloud telemetry into clear, actionable security outcomes with AI embedded throughout the detection engineering lifecycle. A multidimensional engineering role at the intersection of automation, cloud architecture, threat behavior analysis, detection engineering supporting analyst investigation workflows.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and operate an AI-native cloud detection pipeline that aggregates, correlates, enriches, deduplicates and prioritizes signals before analyst investigation
* Build and tune high-fidelity detections that improve coverage across cloud control-plane, data plane and management-plane activity, identity and access, network, container and Kubernetes and security posture.
* Use lower-fidelity and behavioral signals as investigation context, while ensuring known high-confidence detections are consistently escalated for security investigation
* Integrate and correlate telemetry from WIZ, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, AWS GuardDuty, Microsoft Sentinel and other cloud-native or CNAPP sources . Apply hands-on Wiz experience to interpret posture findings, attack paths, identity and exposure context, cloud events, runtime findings and threat detections and improve detection workflows
* Develop behavioral baselines and entity-centric analytics across users, IP addresses, identities and cloud resources . Create reusable dashboards, dynamic lookups and enrichment patterns enabling rapid pivots / drilldowns from an alert to related resource, identity, inventory and historical data
* Own the detection lifecycle from threat hypothesis and telemetry assessment through development, peer review, testing, deployment, tuning, documentation and retirement
* Embed AI across the detection lifecycle to accelerate detection creation and tuning, while ensuring engineering controls and human judgment govern the outcomes
* Finetune detections using historical data, controlled simulations, purple-team exercises, attack emulation and lessons learned from incidents and threat hunts
* Use detection-as-code practices, Git, CI/CD and automated testing to deliver controlled, repeatable and auditable content changes . Partner with Threat Hunting and Response, CSOC analysts, cloud platform teams, data onboarding, threat intelligence and automation teams to close visibility gaps and operationalize detections
Automate enrichment and triage using Python, APIs, SOAR workflows and AI-assisted approaches, with appropriate human oversight for security decisions . Measure and improve detection coverage, precision, false-positive rate, investigation volume, alert latency, data quality and analyst effort  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security, detection engineering, security analytics, threat hunting, incident response or security platform engineering
* Working knowledge of Azure and AWS security architectures, respective cloud domains and workloads
* Understanding of cloud telemetry and logging sources such as Azure Activity and Diagnostic logs, Entra ID logs, AWS CloudTrail, AWS CloudWatch and GuardDuty findings
* Experience in working with CNAPP bundles or developing and tuning detections in Wiz, Vega or cloud-native security platforms
* Proficiency in KQL and at least one scripting or programming language such as Python. CloudShell understanding is expected
* Familiarity with AI/LLM-assisted security investigation, agentic workflows or machine-learning approaches to signal enrichment and triage . Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, threat-informed defense, entity mapping, correlation, enrichment and alert prioritization
* Ability to investigate complex datasets, distinguish true security risk from operational noise and communicate engineering decisions clearly . Experience collaborating across security operations, cloud engineering and platform teams in a global environment.
Experience with detection-as-code, Sigma or YAML-based content, Git, CI/CD, unit/integration testing and safe deployment or rollback practices . Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation or equivalent. Background in threat intelligence, purple teaming, red teaming, incident response or cloud threat research  

**Desirable Requirement:**

  
  

* Relevant certifications such as AZ-500, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, GIAC Cloud Security certifications, CCSP or equivalent practical expertise.
* GIAC Cloud Forensics Responder (GCFR)

title: Structural Design Engineer (Concrete & Steel)
description:
ON-SITE IN HYDERABAD ONLY. PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING.

This is a full-time role at our office in Hyderabad, India. Remote work, hybrid work, or working from any other city or office is not possible. Do not apply if you cannot work from our Hyderabad office. If you live outside Hyderabad, apply only if you will relocate to Hyderabad before joining.

Analyse and design reinforced concrete and structural steel structures, from concept through detailed design and construction support, from our Hyderabad design office.

Please read before applying. This role needs hands-on structural analysis and design experience in both concrete and steel. Do not apply if your experience is:

Drafting or BIM modelling only, without structural analysis and design experience.

Site supervision, quantity surveying, or project coordination only.

Limited exclusively to concrete or exclusively to steel.

Reliance on software outputs without understanding assumptions, boundary conditions, and structural behaviour.

About Invicta-Tech

Invicta-Tech is a digital design and construction advisory firm specialising in BIM and technology-driven delivery for complex projects across KSA and the GCC. We work with contractors, consultants and asset owners to turn models, drawings and point clouds into measurable, client-ready deliverables aligned with ISO 19650, project EIRs and BEPs.

Our work spans BIM production (LOD 200-500), model coordination and clash management, BIM automation and asset handover, across infrastructure & landscape, airports, hospitality, giga projects, industrial and logistics facilities. Our delivery team is based in Hyderabad, India.

About the role

We are seeking a Structural Design Engineer to analyse and design reinforced concrete and structural steel structures, from concept development through detailed design and construction support. The role requires sound engineering judgement, practical knowledge of construction methods, and the ability to deliver safe, coordinated, and economical designs.

You will join our Structural Engineering team and report to our Managing Director.

What you will do

Develop structural schemes and assess suitable framing systems for concrete and steel structures.

Perform structural analysis and design for gravity, wind, seismic, and other applicable loads.

Design reinforced concrete foundations, slabs, beams, columns, walls, and associated structural elements.

Design structural steel members, stability systems, bracing, and connections within the agreed project scope.

Assess strength, stability, deflection, drift, vibration, and other relevant serviceability requirements.

Prepare clear design calculations, structural reports, specifications, and design sketches.

Guide and review structural drawings and models prepared by BIM modellers and detailers.

Coordinate structural requirements with architects, civil and MEP engineers, geotechnical consultants, and contractors.

Review shop drawings, material submissions, and technical queries for compliance with the design intent.

Support site and construction queries remotely (site photos, RFIs and technical queries) and resolve construction issues within the assigned scope.

Follow internal checking procedures and maintain clear records of assumptions, revisions, and design decisions.

What we are looking for (must-have)

3-6 years of hands-on structural design experience.

Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.

Demonstrable hands-on experience designing both reinforced concrete and structural steel structures.

Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load paths, lateral stability, and foundation behaviour.

Working knowledge of the structural codes and loading standards applicable to the project location.

Proficiency in structural analysis software such as ETABS, SAP2000, SAFE, STAAD.Pro, Robot, or equivalent tools appropriate to the work.

Ability to validate software results using independent calculations and engineering judgement.

Practical understanding of concrete reinforcement detailing, steel connections, and constructability.

Ability to read, prepare, and review structural drawings and technical documentation.

Strong coordination skills and clear written and verbal communication.

Ability to manage assigned deliverables, deadlines, and quality requirements.

Experience with Revit, Tekla Structures, and BIM coordination workflows.

Good to know: proficiency in every software package listed is not required; strong capability in relevant tools is sufficient. A postgraduate degree is not mandatory where you demonstrate the required design competence.

Good to have

Master's degree in Structural Engineering.

Professional engineering registration, chartership, or progress toward a relevant qualification.

Experience with connection-design tools such as IDEA StatiCa or equivalent.

Experience with seismic design, dynamic analysis, or complex structural systems.

Knowledge of post-tensioned concrete, composite construction, precast concrete, or long-span steel structures.

Experience assessing and strengthening existing structures.

Site experience and familiarity with fabrication, erection, and temporary stability considerations.

Ability to automate calculations or repetitive tasks using spreadsheets, Python, or other suitable tools.

Experience optimising material quantities and evaluating alternative structural solutions.

Success in this role

Success means delivering accurate, well-documented designs on schedule, producing coordinated and buildable solutions, and resolving technical issues with sound engineering judgement.

What we offer

Hands-on design work on live projects from day one.

A small, senior team where your work is visible.

Competitive pay based on experience.

Location and work mode

Hyderabad, India. Full-time, on-site in our design office.

How to apply

Apply here on Indeed with your CV. Your CV must list the concrete and steel structures you designed, the analysis software you used, and your role on each. In your application, tell us briefly about one structure you designed: the structural system, the loads that governed, and how you checked the software results. Do not share client-confidential files.

Pay: ₹65,000.00 - ₹105,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* Participate in Scrum meetings with other team members, including sprint planning and estimating; backlog refinement; daily Scrum meetings; sprint retrospectives, and sprint reviews
* Create, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using LUA in the internal automation framework.

* Continuously evaluate and improve test coverage, reliability, and execution performance
* Contribute to defining QA best practices, standards, and processes within the team

* Working knowledge of LUA scripting (or strong scripting fundamentals with willingness to ramp up quickly in LUA).

title: Staff Enterprise Integrations Analyst*
description:

The ideal candidate is a strong technical builder who can translate business requirements into scalable architectures, establish engineering standards, make key technology decisions, and work directly with engineers to deliver production-grade solutions.You will provide technical leadership across data engineering, system integrations, APIs, cloud infrastructure, security, and enterprise applications. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Integration Engineers, AI Engineers, Product Managers, Security, and business stakeholders to build reliable platforms that connect enterprise systems and make trusted data available across the organization.

**What You'll Do**

### **Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across Snowflake, AWS, Salesforce, APIs, integrations, and enterprise applications
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable technical architectures and implementation plans
* Define architectural patterns, engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and technical guardrails

* Evaluate new technologies and determine where they should fit within the enterprise technology landscape

* Establish standards for database, schema, table, warehouse, and role design
* Design efficient ELT/ETL architectures for batch, near-real-time, and event-driven workloads

* Define patterns for secure data access, RBAC, data masking, auditing, and governance

title: Delivery Director
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**

Proven experience building, scaling and leading complex delivery organisations at scale (50+ people) spanning engineering, QA and delivery, including experience managing managers.

* A delivery and operator mindset first. Genuine fluency across data and digital product engineering, sufficient to work credibly with Tech Leads and architects on trade-offs, quality and risk, without requiring a hands-on engineering background yourself.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, across technical, commercial and client audiences.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Eligible to work in India.

Nice to Have

* A formal delivery or PMO background, or certification (Scrum, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

Location and Travel

Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.

Able to travel to Vancouver, London, and Melbourne twice a year.

Compliance

Serves as subject matter expert on the SLA, milestones, and/or deliverables, and manages any escalations related to policy non-compliance. Leverages data to anticipate and mitigate risk and negative business impacts by ensuring compliance with agreed-upon terms, communicating delay potential to stakeholders, and driving the execution of contingency plans cross-functionally and/or cross-regionally as needed.

Procurements and Contracts

* Leads contract and price negotiation activities for multiple purchasing categories cross-functionally and ensures that price, capacity, and strategic business needs are met, while also reflecting Microsoft's cross-functional engagements with suppliers. Anticipates negotiation setbacks, proactively drives action to mitigate contract disagreements, and coaches others on negotiation best practices across internal sourcing teams.

Trains external stakeholders during onboarding, and identifies engagement programs to improve supplier performance to achieve business goals.

You will play a key role in modernizing legacy systems into **cloud\-native, microservices\-based, and event\-driven architectures**, ensuring high availability, performance, and extensibility. You will also guide teams on adopting best practices around **observability, fault tolerance, and CI/CD pipelines**.

The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and evolution of the organization's end user technology ecosystem. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for the Microsoft 365 platform and related productivity, collaboration, and security services — driving adoption, standardization, and innovation across the enterprise.


The EUC Architect partners closely with business stakeholders, IT operations teams, security, and enterprise architecture to ensure the end user environment is modern, resilient, and aligned with organizational objectives. This individual operates at both the strategic and hands\-on technical level, owning architectural decisions from concept through implementation.

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and enforce tenant configuration standards, governance policies, and design patterns across all M365 workloads
* Lead architectural decisions for Microsoft Copilot adoption, including readiness assessments, data governance prerequisites, and rollout strategy
* Design and maintain identity and access architecture in partnership with the IAM team, including Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and hybrid identity models
* Architect Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager solutions for device management, compliance policies, application delivery, and Autopilot provisioning
* Establish architecture for Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, eDiscovery, Compliance Manager) and advise on data governance posture
* Drive the strategy for Microsoft Viva, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), and low\-code/no\-code citizen development governance

**End User Computing Strategy**
-------------------------------

* Define the long\-term EUC strategy spanning physical endpoints (Windows, macOS), virtual desktop infrastructure (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365\), and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) via Microsoft Intune
* Lead endpoint lifecycle architecture including OS imaging, patching strategy, hardware standards, and Windows 11 migration planning
* Architect solutions for remote and hybrid work scenarios, ensuring performance, security, and user experience parity regardless of location
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and communicate business value and architectural impact to leadership

**Governance \& Standards**

* Develop and maintain EUC architecture standards, reference architectures, and design documentation

* Ensure EUC architecture aligns with regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, FINRA, GDPR) as applicable to the business

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on EUC and M365 capabilities, roadmap, and investment priorities
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, networking, and application teams to ensure integrated, cohesive solutions
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to EUC engineers and administrators
* Represent EUC architecture in governance forums, architecture review boards, and vendor engagements
* Partner with Microsoft account teams and FastTrack resources to leverage available programs and stay ahead of platform changes

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in an architecture or senior engineering role focused on end user computing or Microsoft 365\.

	+ **Collaboration \& Productivity:** Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Viva
	+ **Identity \& Access:** Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management
	+ **Device Management:** Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot
	+ **Security:** Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365
	+ **Compliance:** Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, eDiscovery
	+ **Automation \& Platform:** Power Platform, Microsoft Graph API
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing M365 tenant architecture in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity models, Azure AD Connect, and cloud\-only identity scenarios
* Experience with virtual desktop technologies (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms and their integration with M365 tooling (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Strong documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, reference designs, and decision records

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level command of M365 platform capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns
* **Strategic Vision:** Ability to translate business requirements into a coherent, future\-state EUC architecture
* **Communication:** Clear and compelling communicator to both technical and executive audiences
* **Problem Solving:** Structured thinker who can diagnose complex, cross\-domain issues and drive resolution
* **Collaboration:** Builds trust across teams; effective in cross\-functional and matrixed environments
* **Governance Mindset:** Proactively establishes guardrails and standards without creating unnecessary friction

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Microsoft certifications, including one or more of:


	+ Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
	+ Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot for M365 deployment planning and AI\-readiness assessments
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and their application in enterprise EUC environments
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.)
* Background in enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman)
